data.description: Embrace serene and sustainable living in DAMAC Riverside, the highly awaited community by the master developer.

data.answer:
Drawing upon the achievements of DAMAC Lagoons, DAMAC Properties proudly introduces DAMAC Riverside, a new flagship development poised to elevate standards of scale and luxury.

Nestled in the heart of Dubai, DAMAC Riverside embodies the essence of coastal living, inviting residents to immerse themselves in a lifestyle embraced by serene water lagoons and pristine sandy beaches. Thoughtfully designed, the community showcases an exquisite selection of 4 and 5-bedroom townhouses. Catering to families seeking a serene retreat or individuals yearning for a peaceful backdrop, DAMAC Riverside offers a harmoniously balanced and enriching lifestyle.

DAMAC Riverside neighborhood for sale is divided into two sub-clusters: Green Vein, where you can embrace green parks and nature right next to your homes, and Water Vein, offering plenty of exciting water spaces and scenic lagoon views. Green Vein and Water Vein comprise 4 and 5-bedroom townhouses with floor areas starting from 2300 sq. ft. The ground plus 1 and ground plus 2 units have a spacious living and dining area, bedrooms and a balcony. Both sub-communities have many amenities related to Food and Well-being, Health and Activity, and Social and Culture.

The community has a distinct charm, drawing home buyers and investors from around the globe to relish its meticulously designed environment. It's a residential enclave that has a unique vacation vibe. Once completed, it will be a hub of cultural events, health initiatives, and culinary delights.

Public Transportation in Riverside

It is about 15 minutes from the Blue metro link. The planned rapid transit line will be the third metro line after the Green and Red lines

Supermarkets in Riverside

Mango Hypermarket is just 9 minutes away. Located in Dubai Investment Park 2, it offers a wide array of products, from groceries to household items, electronics, apparel, and more. Mango Hypermarket 3 caters to the diverse needs of shoppers in the area.

Grand hypermarket Jebel Ali is 18 minutes away and it offers various grocery and daily essential items.

Shopping Malls Near Riverside

DAMAC Mall, situated in DAMAC Hills, is 9 minutes away from Riverside. The 110,000-square-foot space houses 30 shops and 10 food and beverage outlets.

Moreover, City Center Meisem is 14 minutes away. It is a retail hub in the heart of Meisem, offering a diverse array of shopping, dining, and entertainment options. With its convenient location and extensive amenities, it caters to the needs of both residents and visitors seeking a vibrant urban experience.

Schools Near Riverside

Fairgreen International School and Ranches Primary School are a 10-minute drive from the community. South View School is 14 minutes away from the Riverside area. South View School is also easily accessible, situated only 14 minutes away from the Riverside area. Additionally, parents seeking quality nursery options will find British Orchard Nursery in Dubai Silicon Oasis and Chubby Cheeks Nursery at Skycourt Towers within a 20-minute drive, ensuring that comprehensive educational and healthcare needs are well catered to within reach.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques Near Riverside Area

Al Sahabah Masjid is located around 9 minutes away from the area. The worship place is inside the Jebel Ali community. For Christian residents, the nearest option is the Christ Church Jebel Ali. At the same distance, you can find a Hindu temple and gurudwara.

Clinics and Hospitals in Riverside Dubai

NMC Royal Hospital, Dubai Investment Park, is 14 minutes from the Riverside area. With state-of-the-art technology and a team of highly skilled medical professionals, NMC Royal Hospital offers a comprehensive range of healthcare services to its patients.

Riverside DAMAC Neighborhood Location & Nearby Areas

Riverside Dubai is located near key areas such as Dubai Investment Park (DIP), Expo City, and Emaar South.
EXPO 2020 is 16 minutes away from the location.

Riverside has so much to do, from enjoying a spa-like experience in the essential oil lakes to listening to the eccentric music at the Floating Opera. The Green Vein section also offers activities like a clubhouse, amphitheater, and game zones. You can also take culinary classes or hold BBQ parties.

Restaurants In Riverside Dubai

Located in Water Vein, the Island Restaurant will provide an unparalleled dining experience focusing on culinary excellence amidst the splendor of nature.

Portofino Ristorante is another restaurant in the Water Vein sub-community, where the rich flavors of Italy blend seamlessly with the coastal sophistication. Indulge in authentic Italian delights while enjoying breathtaking waterfront views. The best part is that you can only reach the eateries by boat.

Beaches Near Riverside 

Although the community is home to various water features, it is a little away from the beaches. The nearest option is the JBR Beach. With its stunning views of the Arabian Gulf and vibrant atmosphere, JBR Beach provides an idyllic setting for relaxation and enjoyment, making it a quintessential Dubai experience.

Hotels Near Riverside Dubai

Nestled near DAMAC Riverside, Rove Expo City Hotel stands just 13 minutes away, offering modern accommodations and easy access to nearby attractions. Additionally, Holiday Inn, Dubai Al Maktoum Airport, an IHG Hotel, is situated a mere 15-minute drive away, providing guests with comfortable lodging options and seamless connectivity to Dubai's bustling airport and beyond. These hotels further enhance the accessibility and convenience of the DAMAC Riverside area, ensuring a well-rounded and enjoyable experience for residents and visitors alike.

Attractions and Landmarks Near Riverside

Dubai Butterfly Garden, located just 19 minutes from Riverside Dubai, offers visitors a captivating glimpse into the enchanting world of butterflies amidst lush greenery and vibrant floral displays. With its stunning butterfly species and picturesque landscape, the garden provides a serene oasis for nature enthusiasts and families alike to explore and admire.

Similarly, IMG Worlds of Adventure, situated at the same distance from Riverside Dubai, is one of the world's largest indoor theme parks, spanning over 1.5 million square feet.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness, and Beauty

Riverside Water Vein introduces an innovative fitness concept centered around water. Residents can partake in various aquatic fitness activities and dynamic hydro workouts. The state-of-the-art aquatic gyms are meticulously crafted to optimize exercise routines, seamlessly integrating innovation, practicality, and visual allure for a comprehensive fitness journey. Additionally, jogging trails and yoga decks overlooking the water provide further avenues for wellness and tranquility.

You can also participate in various floating sports, including football, basketball, and volleyball, adding water elements to make these games more interesting. There is also a water park with interactive and adventurous activities for kids and adults. Similarly, Riverside Green Vein has an outdoor kids' play area and callisthenic workout stations equipped with TRX training.

Although the community has various facilities, there are a few things you need to consider before investing in the properties. One factor is DAMAC Riverside’s distance from public transportation. Currently, there is a metro station or bus stop very close to the area. However, once the Blue Line project is completed, it will be quite convenient for residents to commute. The public transportation initiative will also enhance the value of the projects within Riverside.

How far Riverside community is from Expo 2020?

The area is about 16 minutes drive away from the Expo 2020 site.

What are the amenities in DAMAC Riverside Dubai?

The community will have many facilities for its residents, including restaurants, a floating cinema, a floating opera, a proposal deck, a clubhouse, and peace rooms.

What are the unit types in the area?

You can find 4 and 5-bedroom townhouses in the Riverside community.
Here is the Riverside Dubai location map to better understand the area and surrounding neighborhoods.

data.content:
Want to enjoy a tranquil lifestyle with fantastic aquatic and green facilities? DAMAC Riverside provides an opportunity to find your dream home amid verdant landscapes and stunning waterscapes.

Offering exceptional lagoon living, Riverside is an upcoming community in Dubai located near Expo 2020 and Dubai Investment Park. It is DAMAC’s fourth master development near Al Maktoum International Airport. After the successful launch of Damac Lagoons, this newest phase is set to yield high ROI’s.

DAMAC Riverside enjoys a prime central location strategically positioned between Jebel Ali Al Hibab Road and Emirates Road. This strategic placement guarantees quick access to prominent destinations across Dubai and beyond, making it an optimal choice for seamless travel and connectivity.

nodes.title: Riverside
nodes.about:
Discover Riverside Townhouses for sale in Dubai by DAMAC. This premium community is strategically positioned next to E611 Emirates Road, Etihad Rail, and the upcoming blue metro line, ensuring unmatched connectivity and growth potential. Only 25-30 minutes from Downtown Dubai and within a 10-minute drive to Al Maktoum Airport, Riverside Dubai is perfect for investors and families. 

The luxurious 4 & 5 bedroom townhouses promise significant returns, as seen in the initial clusters of DAMAC Lagoons. With operations from DXB Airport moving to Al Maktoum in the next decade, this is an ideal investment opportunity.

Riverside Dubai’s first phase features two distinctive clusters: Water Vein and Green Vein. Water Veins offers a serene, lagoon-themed environment for those who cherish waterfront living, while Green Vein provides a lush, nature-inspired retreat for a peaceful lifestyle. Embrace the luxury and tranquility of Riverside by DAMAC, a community designed for maximum returns and serene living.

nodes.title: Green Vein
nodes.about:
Luxury living reaches new heights at Damac Green Vein by Damac Properties, the latest development nestled within the prestigious Damac Riverside community, featuring 4 and 5-bedroom townhouses. This exclusive residential enclave offers an unparalleled fusion of opulence, tranquility, and wellness. With lush green surroundings and open parks, the facades set a new standard for refined living in the heart of Dubai.

Green Vein strategic location within the Damac Riverside community allows residents to enjoy easy access to the vibrant city life of Dubai while still being able to retreat to their own oasis of serenity. Whether it's indulging in gourmet dining experiences, unwinding at the Zen Spa, or engaging in outdoor activities, the locality offers a lifestyle that caters to every desire.

Residents have the opportunity to choose from exquisitely designed residences, each meticulously crafted to blend seamlessly with the natural surroundings while exuding sophistication and charm. From tree-lined views to holistic wellness experiences, every aspect of life is curated to elevate the senses and provide a truly enriching lifestyle.

nodes.title: Water Vein
nodes.about:
Luxury Living at DAMAC Water Vein: Elevate your lifestyle at the exquisite DAMAC Water Vein by Damac Properties, a premier development within the sought-after DAMAC Riverside community, offering luxurious 4 and 5-bedroom townhouses. 

This exclusive residential area is a perfect blend of lavishness, serenity, and waterfront elegance. With its prime location along the scenic lagoon, DAMAC Water Vein sets a new standard for sophisticated living in the heart of Riverside Dubai.

Strategically located in the Riverside DAMAC neighborhood, residents benefit from both the tranquility of waterfront living and the bustling city life of Dubai. From elite dining to relaxing at the essential oil lake , or exploring floating outdoor activities, DAMAC Riverside offers a lifestyle that meets every expectation. Choose from elegantly designed homes that harmonize with the lagoon views, offering a living experience that enhances wellness and heightens luxury. You can also check out Green Vein if you are a nature lover!
